tasks.short: Visit beta sites and evaluate software performance.

steps.what: Visit beta testing sites and watch the software.
Evaluate software performance with the people there.
Log what the visit showed about performance.

tasks.design: The visit and the evaluation stay on the site, with the people there. The log on {PROJECT} records what the tester already evaluated. A remote dashboard does not replace the visit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Beta feedback arrived as mail after the visit, with the performance complaint blurred.
tasks.enabler_now: A log can store the evaluation. It cannot make the visit.
tasks.still_hard: A site whose network and habits the lab does not have stays a visit.
tasks.human_edge: The tester sees the pause the user feels, which a counter may miss.
tasks.altitude: The visit has a log. The travel, the watch and the evaluation stay.

reach.task: Read the visit log before the next build
reach.learn: Which site, and what was slow

evidence.claim: A visit log is a record. Evaluating performance on a site is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester visits and evaluates. Fixing performance is the developer. A lab recreation is a different task.
Structured input: site, build, what was slow, what the tester wrote. Producer is the tester after the visit. An empty evaluation is not logged.
Visit time stays. The log is not a measurement the site did not have.
unknowns: Which beta sites can be visited?
What may be written down about the people there?
research_questions: How often is a site complaint missing from the record?

already_counted.description: The visit is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire visit logs for sites that left the beta.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If a site cannot be visited, there is no evaluation to log. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct historical analyses of test results.

steps.what: Pull historical test results for the named area.
Count passes, fails and repeated results.
Draft an analysis that quotes only those counts.

loop.input: the counts for the named area and period
loop.output: an analysis that quotes only those counts
loop.check: every number must equal a count; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a period with no results is marked empty
loop.why_not_simpler: what the history means for the next release is the reading

steps.what: Conduct the reading and accept the historical analyses.

tasks.design: Historical results are pulled and counted on {BI}. The draft quotes only those counts. The tester conducts the reading and accepts the analysis, or rejects it. A count is not a conclusion about the next release.
tasks.previous_blocker: History was rebuilt in a private sheet before each release discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Passes and fails over a period are a query. What they imply is not.
tasks.still_hard: A trend caused by a changed suite, not a changed product, stays a reading.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows when the history is lying because the scripts changed.

ambition.what: Read the history each release, not only when a failure repeats.

tasks.altitude: The counts are ready. The reading stays, and it can happen every release.

reach.task: See the accepted analysis for their area

evidence.claim: Counts of past results are a query. An accepted analysis is a reading of those counts.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester analyses history. Fixing a repeated failure is the developer. Storing the raw results is a different task.
Structured input: area, period, result, build. Producer is the result store. A number that is not a count is discarded.
The reading is remaining time. Empty history is shown as empty.
unknowns: Are past results in one store?
Do script changes get marked so a trend can be explained?
research_questions: How often is a repeated failure invisible until release?

already_counted.description: Reading the analysis is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Mark periods where the suite changed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If results are scattered, the pull is incomplete and the tester still reads what is there. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate or recommend software for testing or tracking.

steps.what: List testing and tracking needs from recent work.
Evaluate software for testing and bug tracking.
Draft a note that cites only the evaluation.

loop.input: the needs and the judgements the tester wrote
loop.output: a note that cites only those lines
loop.check: every claim cites an evaluation line; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a need with no judgement is left open
loop.why_not_simpler: which software to recommend is the decision

steps.what: Recommend software for testing, or recommend none.
Record the recommendation for a later purchase.

tasks.design: Needs are listed from recent work. The tester evaluates the software. The note cites only that evaluation. The tester recommends one, or none. The record does not buy anything. No vendor is chosen by the draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tool choices were a preference with no list of needs.
tasks.enabler_now: A need can be listed. A recommendation cannot be computed from a brochure.
tasks.still_hard: A tool that fits the demo and not the suite stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which need is real and which is fashion.
tasks.altitude: The needs list and the note take less rewriting. The evaluation and the recommendation stay.

reach.task: See the recommendation and the needs it cites

evidence.claim: A note that must cite the evaluation can be checked. Recommending software cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester evaluates and recommends. Buying is procurement. Installing a chosen program is a different task.
Structured input: need, candidate name the tester wrote, judgement. Producer is the tester. A claim with no evaluation line is discarded.
Evaluation time stays. The record is not an order.
unknowns: Who is allowed to recommend a tool?
research_questions: How often is a tool bought that the suite does not use?

already_counted.description: The evaluation is already the remaining time on that step.

approvals.approved_version: recommendation the tester made, including none

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If needs are not written, the list is empty and the evaluation stays a conversation. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Modify existing software to correct errors or performance.

steps.what: Read the errors in the existing software.
Draft a change that quotes the failing lines only.

loop.input: the failing lines the tester marked
loop.output: a proposed change that quotes those lines and states the edit
loop.check: every quoted line must be one the tester marked; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; an unmarked line is not changed
loop.why_not_simpler: whether the change is correct is a review

steps.what: Modify the software and adapt it to new hardware.
Check whether performance improved after the change.
Review the modification before it is kept.
Record the modification the developer kept.

tasks.design: The tester reads the errors and may see a draft that quotes only lines they marked. They modify the software, including a change for new hardware, and check performance. The developer reviews before the modification is kept. The record follows that review. A draft is not applied on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: Small fixes were made on a branch nobody reviewed, and a performance change was hard to undo.
tasks.enabler_now: Marked lines can be quoted. A correct modification is not a quote.
tasks.still_hard: Hardware the tester cannot run, and an error whose cause is still unknown, stay hard.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows the error. The developer knows whether the change is safe to keep.
tasks.altitude: The quote of failing lines takes less time. The modification, the performance check and the developer's review stay.

reach.learn: Which lines changed, and what the check showed

evidence.claim: A draft that quotes marked lines can be checked. Modifying software so it is correct cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester modifies and checks. The developer reviews before the change is kept. Initial debugging, without a change, is a different task.
Structured input: defect id, file, line the tester marked, hardware name. Producer is the tester. A draft quoting an unmarked line is discarded.
Modification time stays. Developer review is not the tester's saving.
unknowns: May this role change product code, or only tests?
Who must review before a change is kept?
research_questions: How often is a modification kept with no second person?

already_counted.description: Modifying the software is already the remaining time on that step.
The developer's review is already remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire draft changes that were not kept.

approvals.approved_version: review the developer recorded for that modification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the tester may not change the code, the modification stays with the developer and this task shrinks to the reading. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Beta visits stay visits. History is counted, then read. A tool recommendation can be none. A code change is kept only after a developer reviews it.
reach: A developer sees the visit log and the accepted analysis.
Procurement sees a recommendation that cites the evaluation.
skills_to_grow: Reject an analysis whose numbers are not the counts.
Do not keep a modification the developer has not reviewed.
role.ambitious_version: History can be read each release, and a modification quotes only lines the tester marked.

job.title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
